author: Verified Customer
raw_text: The curation on Nykaa Fashion iOS app is gorgeous. I use the wishlist as an outfit planner for an upcoming cousin's wedding in April. But when trying to coordinate a lehenga with matching jewelry, there's no way to compare pieces side by side or check drape style. So everything sits in wishlist until the event gets closer.

author: Verified Customer
raw_text: Return pickup experience has been unpredictable lately. Because of that, even if I have 10 western wear items saved in my wishlist, I hesitate to pull the trigger on Rs 3000+ tops unless I am 100% sure about the fit. If returns were seamless with instant exchanges, I would buy right away.

author: Verified Customer
raw_text: Whenever I shortlist 3 black blazers on Nykaa Fashion, I can't easily tell which one has shoulder pads or what the lining material is. The comparison experience is non-existent. I keep toggling between tabs and get decision fatigue, then close the app without buying.
